workflow_runs.display_title: One record per unit: who holds a phase, what it cost, was it reviewed, is anyone working (gh-503)

head_commit.message:
A review is received, not just requested: two skills, and a derived `findings` obligation (PR #508 review)

Review comment on the shipped `review-phase` member: "I would expect another
element here, invoking superpowers:receiving-code-review. Is it being left at
the implementing agent's discretion?" It was — one skill named, the second in
a parenthesis of fr-goal section 6. And this run is the evidence: every phase
was reviewed inline with neither skill invoked through the harness. `review`
evidence proves an ENTRY exists, not what was done with what it found.

Operator decision u6 (spec 4.E.1):

- Step.skill accepts an ordered list (Step.skills normalises). A one-skill
  step is byte-identical in the model and the dispatch brief. The shipped
  member lists requesting-code-review, then receiving-code-review.
- evidence: [review, findings]. `findings` is DERIVED, never offered
  (--evidence findings= is refused): naming a skill cannot prove it was used,
  so fr gates the outcome it can observe. `fr run resolve --state done`
  refuses while any finding FILED AGAINST THAT PHASE is effectively open in
  the plan journal (the fold `fr journal check` uses; a later record can
  re-open), prints one pasteable `fr journal resolve` line per finding, and
  stores the witness: the ids it saw closed, or `none`.
- Deferral is a phase number, not a new state: file the finding against the
  phase that will fix it. A --global finding stays journal-check's business.
- NOT a third member step. Drift compares member ids, so a new one strands
  every fr-goal cursor in flight; a field cannot, and a test pins it.
- Debt is per obligation: a unit resolved with review= before `findings`
  existed reads `unevidenced: findings (predates that obligation)`. Exit
  codes unchanged.

Five mutations each fail the unit suite; disabling the gate fails the
shipped-shape integration walk, which drives the real `fr journal`. Matrix row
run-review-findings-gate (ci). fr-goal skill + both mirrors; explainer updated
and regenerated (baseline re-render byte-identical first; the page diff is
only the new paragraph). Also fixes a matrix line anchor that had pointed 13
lines above its test with nothing reporting it.

Limit: this enforces that findings END closed — not that the review was
rigorous, nor that a refutation is well reasoned.

Full suite: 3966 passed, 80 skipped, 0 failed; coverage 92.21%.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
